answer: Seats are the scarce thing here. Each identity holds its seat by burning a renewal quill every epoch, and the number of quills the market clears at rises with how many names press for one, so holding k seats costs roughly k squared in burnt stake, not k. Clones cannot pool the burn because the ledger ties one vertex, one receipt, to one voting line: nebula crowds of fresh keys each owe the whole price and each start the delay clock from zero.
